title: 1970s rescue planner
description: Shaggy dark hair, full beard, tan corduroy blazer over an open-collar cream shirt, flared brown trousers, carrying a thick manila production folder.

title: Boston neighborhood charmer
description: Close-cropped brown hair, light stubble, charcoal zip hoodie over a pale T-shirt, blue work jeans, scuffed work boots, carrying a canvas archive duffel.

title: Meticulous records specialist
description: Neatly side-parted dark hair, rectangular black glasses, gray business suit, white shirt and narrow black tie, upright exact posture, holding a calculator and aligned folders.

title: Too-perfect suburban neighbor
description: Clean-shaven, neatly swept dark hair, light blue Oxford shirt with rolled sleeves, dark jeans, brown shoes, polished strained smile, holding a paper coffee cup.

title: Eccentric archive benefactor
description: 1980s swept brown hair, short beard, lavender polo beneath a violet windbreaker, tan slacks, conspicuous colorful running sneakers, holding a white archival shoebox.

title: Loyal-looking local
description: Young clean-shaven square-jawed face, brown baseball cap, plaid flannel over a white T-shirt, faded jeans, tan work boots, holding a folded city map.

title: Bookish barroom uncle
description: 1970s dark swept hair, thick mustache, rust-brown short-sleeve patterned shirt, gold chain, brown trousers, carrying a well-worn paperback.

title: Tired but friendly coach
description: Thick salt-and-pepper beard, untidy dark hair, dark blue athletic pullover, gray sweatpants, trainers, whistle around neck, holding a clipboard.

title: Golden-age leading man
description: 1950s slick side-parted dark hair, clean-shaven face, cream double-breasted suit, maroon pocket square, polished shoes, holding folded reading glasses.

title: Immaculate young attorney
description: Early-2000s clean-shaven dark-haired attorney, navy pinstripe suit, pale blue shirt, burgundy tie, black leather briefcase and a single loose legal page.

title: Press-conference statesman
description: Neat conservative dark haircut, clean-shaven, midnight blue suit, white shirt, bright blue tie, little plain lapel pin, holding a folded newspaper with no readable text.

title: Off-duty aviator
description: 1940s swept dark hair, brown leather flight jacket with cream shearling collar, khaki trousers, brown boots, goggles held in one hand, genial aviator smile.

title: Overconfident field technician
description: Tousled brown hair, light stubble, orange work coveralls tied at the waist over a navy T-shirt, rugged boots, white hardhat under one arm, holding a map tube.

title: Courteous legal consultant
description: Dark hair, crimson round sunglasses, charcoal lawyer suit, red tie, white mobility cane held naturally, calm welcoming expression; civilian Matt Murdock-inspired clothing, no superhero armor.

movie: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
title: Wealthy museum donor
description: Mature square-jawed face, graying dark temples, clean-shaven, expensive dark overcoat over a three-piece slate suit, black gloves, silver watch, holding a visitor badge; civilian Bruce Wayne-inspired, no mask or cape.

title: Suspiciously gracious patron
description: Short bleached-blond hair and pointed blond beard, medieval black-and-gold embroidered brocade tunic, gold chain, dark boots, carrying a rolled parchment, friendly courtly bow.

title: Prohibition-era gentleman
description: 1920s brown fedora, dark slick hair, thin mustache, cream linen three-piece suit and brown tie, two-tone shoes, holding a closed leather ledger.

title: Confident technical consultant
description: Clean-shaven dark-haired engineer, sleek black leather jacket over gray crewneck shirt, charcoal trousers, simple steel wristwatch, holding a small envelope of innocuous office objects.

title: Overfriendly holiday volunteer
description: Dark stubble and tousled brown hair, red Santa coat open over plain gray sweater, red knit hat, dark work trousers, holding a gift-wrapped document box; no weapons.

title: Disarmingly casual wanderer
description: Young dark-haired square-jawed man, gray hooded sweatshirt under black casual jacket, loose dark pants, messenger bag, small folded wings behind shoulders, holding a blank visitor brochure; warm, innocently friendly fallen-angel disguise.
